manifest.name: enrichment-opt-out
manifest.description: One subject's refusal of contact enrichment. While the row exists, no enrichment source writes a new enriched field for the subject, and opting out purges the subject's active enriched fields. Channel identities (external-identity) are untouched: they route messages, they are not enrichment.

migrations.name: create_enrichment_opt_outs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS enrichment_opt_outs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  subject_resource TEXT,
  subject_id TEXT,
  subject_owner TEXT CHECK(subject_owner IN ('host', 'package')),
  subject_owner_package TEXT,
  subject_label TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  opted_out_at TEXT,
  opted_out_by_run_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enrichment_opt_outs_subject_resource ON enrichment_opt_outs(subject_resource);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS enrichment_opt_outs_subject_id ON enrichment_opt_outs(subject_id);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_enrichment_opt_outs
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."enrichment_opt_outs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "subject_resource" TEXT,
  "subject_id" TEXT,
  "subject_owner" TEXT CHECK("subject_owner" IN ('host', 'package')),
  "subject_owner_package" TEXT,
  "subject_label" TEXT,
  "reason" TEXT,
  "opted_out_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "opted_out_by_run_id" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "enrichment_opt_outs_subject_resource"
  ON "accordo"."enrichment_opt_outs"("subject_resource");

CREATE INDEX "enrichment_opt_outs_subject_id"
  ON "accordo"."enrichment_opt_outs"("subject_id");
